qa_pairs.question: How can users access the Nibi cluster and what services are available through its Open OnDemand portal?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can log into the Nibi cluster via the Open OnDemand web portal at https://ondemand.sharcnet.ca/ by signing in with multifactor authentication. This user-friendly interface provides options to open a Bash shell terminal, launch a remote desktop session, and run JupyterLab interactively.

qa_pairs.question: Is it possible to use JupyterLab on the Nibi cluster, and if so, how?
qa_pairs.answer: Yes, JupyterLab can be run interactively on the Nibi cluster through its Open OnDemand portal, which is accessible at https://ondemand.sharcnet.ca/.
